import numpy as np
r=dA_dt
# bin by time, fit r = c*A^p in each bin
edges=np.linspace(0.5,10,8)
for lo,hi in zip(edges[:-1],edges[1:]):
    m=(t>=lo)&(t<hi)
    if m.sum()<5: continue
    X=np.vstack([np.ones(m.sum()),np.log(A[m])]).T
    # fit log(-r)
    ok=r[m]<0
    if ok.sum()>5:
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X[ok],np.log(-r[m][ok]),rcond=None)[0]
        print(f"t[{lo:.2f},{hi:.2f}) n={m.sum()} logfit k={np.exp(c[0]):.3f} p={c[1]:.3f}  pos={np.sum(~ok)}")
    else:
        print(lo,hi,m.sum(),"no neg")
# also linear fit in A for each bin
print("linear in A per bin:")
for lo,hi in zip(edges[:-1],edges[1:]):
    m=(t>=lo)&(t<hi)
    X=np.vstack([np.ones(m.sum()),A[m],A[m]**2]).T
    c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,r[m],rcond=None)
    print(f"{lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}: coef={np.round(c,3)} rms={np.sqrt(np.mean((X@c-r[m])**2)):.4f}")
